textbookBox.concept: Printing began in East Asia. Woodblock printing in China and Japan produced books and Marco Polo carried the technique to Italy.

beats.en: Printing began in East Asia. Woodblock printing in China and Japan produced books and Marco Polo carried the technique to Italy.

beats.en: Around 1448 Johann Gutenberg developed the printing press in Strasbourg, with metal types. The first book he printed was the Bible.

textbookBox.concept: Printing made books cheap and led to a reading public. It spread new ideas, such as Martin Luther's 95 Theses of 1517 which spurred the Protestant Reformation.

beats.en: Printing made books cheap and led to a reading public. It spread new ideas, such as Martin Luther's 95 Theses of 1517 which spurred the Protestant Reformation.
beats.speakEn: Printing made books cheap and led to a reading public. It spread new ideas, such as Martin Luther's 95 Theses of 1517 which spurred the Protestant Reformation.

beats.en: The Church tried to control print through an Index of Prohibited Books. The miller Menocchio was punished for his reading of the Bible.
